purpose: Diagnostic memory and accelerator stream screening using existing Merlin fitter
declaration_scope: Before root inspection of stock gather2030 and primitive timing labels; gather GSIM results already observed
repeat_policy: Average the two complete repeats per case before fitting; retain both raw samples
partition: Use each source manifest's predeclared middle-size heldout cases, including both repeats
engines: GSIM and stock fit separately; Spike is correctness and instruction census only
anticipated_refusals: Two training cases cannot identify two parameters under the shared fitter's four-distinct-points rule. Gather retired instructions and requested bytes are constant, so even those one-parameter screens lack two distinct feature points. Do not weaken these gates.
limitations: One middle heldout case per family, two repeats; insufficient to license production ranking
Requested 64B regions are source address groupings, not physical cache lines, misses or DDR bytes
log2 extent is an exploratory proxy, not an assumed cache capacity or memory mechanism
Primitive windows include CPU issue and fenced completion; fitted coefficients are not pure device service rates
Choosing the best exploratory hypothesis requires fresh independent validation
No source-equivalent ordering, whole program prediction, Jack-reference fit or default production enablement
